Definition: Sum of line revenue (quantity × unit price) in USD.
Number of product lines sold. Not customer visits: the source has no receipt ID.
Total quantity of items sold.
Revenue divided by line items: average value of one product line.
Revenue divided by units: average price paid per item.
Number of days with at least one sale in the current filter.
Revenue divided by trading days. Use this to compare months of different length.
Total revenue for the same filter, one month earlier.
Change in revenue vs the previous month. Blank for January (no earlier data).
Formula / Logic: VAR prev = [Revenue Previous Month] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( prev ), DIVIDE ( [Total Revenue] - prev, prev ) )
Notes: Needs dim_date marked as the date table (it is).

Definition: Revenue from 1 January to the end of the selected period.
Share of the revenue currently shown in the visual (respects slicers).
Share of revenue across all products, ignoring product filters (store/date filters still apply).
Formula / Logic: DIVIDE ( [Total Revenue], CALCULATE ( [Total Revenue], ALL ( dim_product ) ) )

Definition: Share of revenue earned before 11:00, including the 06:00 hour.
Formula / Logic: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Total Revenue], KEEPFILTERS ( dim_time[hour] < 11 ) ), [Total Revenue] )
Notes: KEEPFILTERS keeps any hour / size filter already on the visual.

Definition: Large-size line items as a share of all sized line items (Small, Regular, Large).
Formula / Logic: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Line Items], KEEPFILTERS ( dim_product[size] = "Large" ) ), CALCULATE ( [Line Items], dim_product[size] IN { "Small", "Regular", "Large" } ) )
Notes: KEEPFILTERS keeps any hour / size filter already on the visual.

Definition: One row per product line sold (149,116 rows, 1 Jan – 30 Jun 2023).
One row per calendar day (181 rows). Marked as the date table.
One row per minute of the day (1,440 rows).
Notes: Use hour or day_part for time-of-day analysis.

Definition: One row per store (3 rows): Astoria, Hell's Kitchen, Lower Manhattan.
One row per product (80 rows) with category, type, size and base name.
This list. Not connected to the model.
Revenue for one line: transaction_qty × unit_price.
Price per item on that line, in USD.
Notes: A few products have more than one price over the period.

Definition: Number of items on the line (1–8, mostly 1–2).
Time of sale as text (hh:mm:ss).
Integer date key, yyyymmdd (e.g. 20230115).
Notes: Hidden; used only for the relationship.

Definition: Monday of the week the date falls in.
Year and month as text, e.g. 2023-03.
Weekend for Saturday/Sunday, otherwise Weekday.
Integer time key, hhmm (e.g. 0715 = 7:15am).
Notes: Hidden; used only for the relationship.

Definition: 30-minute bucket label, e.g. 07:30.
Morning (before 11), Midday (11–14), Afternoon (14–17), Evening (17+).
Product name without the size suffix (e.g. "Latte").
Product name as in the source, including size suffix (e.g. "Latte Rg").
Notes: Leading/trailing spaces are trimmed in the ETL. "Jamacian" is a spelling error kept from the source.

Definition: Small / Regular / Large from the Sm / Rg / Lg suffix. "Unlabelled" = a made-to-order drink with no size in its name (Latte, Cappuccino, Espresso shot, Ouro Brasileiro shot). "Not applicable" = bakery, beans, retail and merchandise.
Notes: Sorted by size_order. "Unlabelled" drinks are among the best sellers, so they are not duplicates to remove.

Definition: Top product level: Coffee, Tea, Bakery, Drinking Chocolate, Coffee beans, Branded, Loose Tea, Flavours, Packaged Chocolate.
Middle product level, e.g. Barista Espresso, Brewed Chai tea, Scone.
Beverage for Coffee, Tea and Drinking Chocolate; otherwise Non-beverage.
Typical (median) unit price of the product across the period.
One product sold on one order line, with a quantity.
Notes: Not a customer visit or receipt: the source has no basket ID, so basket size and attach rates cannot be measured.

Definition: Money from sales in USD before costs. No discounts, tax or refunds appear in the source.
A day with at least one sale.
Notes: All 181 days in the period traded.

Definition: Sales before 11:00, including the 06:00 hour.
Notes: The 7–11am window alone is about 46% of revenue.

Definition: One central fact table (sales) joined to descriptive dimension tables (date, time, store, product).
All relationships are many-to-one, filtering from dimension to fact only.
